A letter for Ebad

Written with my whole heart.

Dear Ebad,

Happy birthday, my love. 🎂 Today is the day the world got you, and I am so grateful it did, because you are the best thing that ever happened to me.

You make ordinary days feel like my favourite ones. Your smile, your voice, the way you care without making a big deal of it. All of it feels like home to me.

Thank you for every laugh, for every time you stood by me, and for being you. I hope this year gives you everything you deserve and more, and I hope I get to be next to you for all of it.

Close your eyes, make a wish, and know that I'll be doing everything I can to make it come true. I love you more than I know how to say. 💙

Forever yours,
Ishaal 🕯️✨
